Figure 5: Predicted Medal Allocations for LA 2028 in different τ2. We predicted the number of
medals and gold medals in 2028 under different τ2 values and provided the 95% prediction intervals.
Predicted 2028 Medal Counts under Different τ² Values
It is evident that the predicted medal counts for the 2028 Olympics remain remarkably
consistent across the range of τ2 values considered, from 0.1 to 10. Despite the deliberate
variation in the weakly informative prior's variance parameter, both the total and gold medal
predictions show only minor deviations from the baseline forecast obtained with τ2 = 1. This
close alignment indicates that the posterior inferences are not overly sensitive to the choice of τ2,
thereby reinforcing the stability of our Bayesian framework even under different prior settings.
